status: TERMINAL FOR THIS INVOCATION, AWAITING OPERATOR
kind: registered stop condition reached before any measurement

which_stop_conditions.clause_1_triggered: any of the four synthetic cases fails; case 2 failed
which_stop_conditions.clause_5_triggered: a situation arises in which continuing would require a SECOND revision of the estimand

finding_1_the_prescribed_replacement_is_.statement: the estimand prescribed as the replacement is algebraically identical to the estimand P-0 already used; it is not a replacement
finding_1_the_prescribed_replacement_is_.prescribed: effect = (L_patch - L_clean) / (L_full - L_clean), with L_x = logit_x(a_D) - logit_x(a_R)

numerical_check.method: 200000 independent random draws of the six underlying logits, both formulas evaluated

the_only_differences_are_not_in_the_form: P-0 takes a max over single-token surface forms where the directive writes a single token id; a refinement, not a change of kind
the correct-only inclusion rule is new
finding_1_the_prescribed_replacement_is_.consequence: adopting the prescribed replacement would re-run the identical estimand and reproduce the identical defect, while the record would say an estimand had been replaced. That is a silent failure of exactly the shape OD-017 exists to prevent

finding_2_the_premise_behind_the_replace.the_premise_as_written: pure disruption depresses a_D and a_R by roughly equal amounts, the difference does not move, so effect is approximately 0
finding_2_the_premise_behind_the_replace.why_it_fails: in its own clean run the recipient PREFERS its own answer, so logit(a_R) starts high and logit(a_D) starts low. A patch that destroys the state moves the output toward something uninformative about which token is which, which drags the high one down far more than the low one. The logit DIFFERENCE therefore rises rather than staying put
finding_2_the_premise_behind_the_replace.closed_form: substituting the expected gap of a destroyed state, L_patch = 0, gives effect = -L_clean / (L_full - L_clean), which is strictly positive whenever the recipient prefers its own answer and the donor prefers its own

sweep.method: 20000 draws with L_clean in [-15, -1] and L_full in [1, 15]; no P-0 artifact used

corroboration_from_the_measurement_alrea.note: reported only, and consistent rather than load-bearing
corroboration_from_the_measurement_alrea.reading: the measured value sits where the closed form says it should, which is why the defect is constructional rather than a matter of precision

case_2_random_vector.significance: this is the case the replacement existed to fix, and it is the case that fails

the_four_synthetic_cases_as_run.how_approximately_zero_was_formalised: the 95 percent cluster-bootstrap interval must contain zero at every layer; no numeric tolerance was invented, because a tolerance chosen after the failure it is meant to judge would not be evidence

why_the_agent_does_not_choose_a_differen.the_directive_permits_one_replacement_on: the estimand may be replaced this once
why_the_agent_does_not_choose_a_differen.therefore: making it work requires a SECOND choice of estimand, which section 8 clause 5 registers as a stop
why_the_agent_does_not_choose_a_differen.and_separately: an estimand chosen by the agent after seeing which one failed would be the agent selecting the instrument that decides the question, which is the substance of what the directionality precedent forbids

what_this_does_not_mean: it does not mean no valid estimand exists; it means the agent may not be the one to choose it
it does not resurrect P-0's withheld verdict, which remains withheld and uninterpretable
it says nothing about J-space, the J-lens, the published lenses, the paper, or T
it does not modify EQ1 or EQ2 in any respect
what_was_completed_despite_the_stop: P-0 closed UNINTERPRETABLE with the withheld direction recorded verbatim
OD-011 formally revised so a must-return-positive case is permanently required
the batch-baseline bug fix, which section 2 authorises independently of the estimand question
the correct-both pair count, which is estimand-independent and was computed only after its inclusion rule was pushed
the EQ2 item-accuracy addendum, written as a new file with EQ2 left byte-identical
decisions_reserved_for_the_operator: which estimand, given that a logit-difference recovery ratio is what P-0 already used
whether an estimand must be required to be invariant to a norm-matched destructive patch by construction, rather than checked for it afterwards
whether to proceed instead to P-0c, where the intermediate is defined by construction and this whole class of question does not arise
claim_ceiling: A blocker record. It licenses no claim of any kind, and it is not a finding.
